slides.title: The 5 tasks worth automating first are *never the ones people ask for*.
1 — State capture
slides.body:
Before and after *every change*.
"What changed?" becomes one diff, not one hour.

slides.title: 2 — Config backup + drift alerts
slides.body:
Every device, every day.
Notified when running config *drifts*. Boring. Priceless.

slides.title: 3 — Health checks
slides.body:
The senior engineer's checklist, encoded —
same rigor at *2am as 2pm*.

slides.title: 4 — The restart runbook
slides.body:
What you already restart out of self-defense —
identical, *verified*, every time.

slides.title: 5 — Alert enrichment
slides.body:
State, recent changes, last occurrence —
attached *before a human opens it*.

slides.title: Notice the pattern
slides.body:
None of these change the network.
Automation earns trust by being right *before it earns write access*.

slides.title: The demo impresses. The discipline pays.
slides.body:
